# GraphCondition

One transition condition, `parameter <op> value`. All of a transition's
conditions must pass for it to fire.

## Parameters

- `parameter`: A string. Name of a declared graph parameter.
- `op`: A string (see [CmpOp](CmpOp.md)). Comparison operator: `lt`, `le`, `gt`, `ge`, `eq`, or `ne`.
- `value`: A float. Right-hand side of the comparison.
